items.quote: Sie dürfen den Vertrag deshalb innerhalb von drei Monaten nach Erhalt dieses Schreibens kostenlos und ohne Kündigungsfrist beenden, frühestens zum Wirksamwerden der Preisänderung.
items.computation: The letter gives a period, not a fixed date: three months 'nach Erhalt' (after receipt), not after the printed date. The actual day of receipt is not stated, so the earliest plausible start is used: the letter's own date, Wed 18.11.2026 (a company letter has no statutory deemed-delivery rule, unlike an authority's). Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of receipt itself is not counted, so counting starts 19.11.2026. Under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB a period of months ends on the day of the last month that bears the same number as the start day: three months from 18.11.2026 is 18.02.2027, a Thursday — no weekend/holiday shift needed. If the letter actually arrived later than 18.11.2026 (which is likely for ordinary post), the three-month period — and therefore the final day to cancel — would run correspondingly later than 18.02.2027.
